title: CapturePack timeline.json
description: Schema for timeline.json, the OPTIONAL machine-readable event log of a video CapturePack (format 0.1.0). Explicit image packs MUST omit this file. The timeline is append-only during capture, sorted ascending by t_ms, and replayable: when a replay video exists, t0 SHOULD be the instant of the replay's first frame so that t_ms doubles as a video seek position. Event types are namespaced dot-paths: core.* (defined in 0.1.0), input.* (reserved for V2 — not emitted yet), plugin.<name>.* (plugin-defined). Readers MUST skip events of unknown type and SHOULD preserve them when rewriting a pack. Unknown additional properties are deliberately allowed for forward compatibility (SPEC.md §13). See SPEC.md §10 for the normative definition; where schema and prose disagree, the prose wins.

t0.description: The absolute anchor instant, ISO 8601 with timezone (e.g. "2026-07-27T14:02:53.104+09:00"). Every event's t_ms is a millisecond offset relative to this instant. When a replay video exists, t0 SHOULD be the replay's first frame; otherwise the capture trigger instant is a natural choice.

events.description: The events, sorted ascending by t_ms (stable order for equal values). Writers only append while capturing — events are never rewritten or reordered during a session. May be empty.

t_ms.description: Milliseconds relative to t0. May be negative for events that occurred before t0.

type.description: Namespaced lowercase dot-path identifying the event kind. Namespaces in 0.1.0: core.* — events from the capture tool itself (core.capture.triggered, core.annotation.added, core.export.created); input.* — RESERVED for V2 user-input events (input.mouse.click, input.key.down, input.window.focus); writers MUST NOT emit them yet; plugin.<name>.* — events from plugin <name>, where <name> matches a declared plugin. Readers skip unknown types.

source.description: The component that emitted the event: "core" for core.* events; the plugin name (matching plugins/<name>/ and the <name> segment of the type) for plugin.<name>.* events.

data.description: OPTIONAL type-specific payload; absent means {}. Conventional fields for 0.1.0 core events — core.capture.triggered: {hotkey}; core.annotation.added: {annotation_id, annotation_type} matching annotations.json; core.export.created: {filename}. Conventions, not requirements: readers MUST tolerate their absence. Keep payloads small and structured — the timeline is an index into the capture, not a data store (bulk data belongs under plugins/).
